mechanism_narrative: A strong increase in GDP growth rate indicates a growing economy, which leads to higher consumer spending and subsequently drives up the S&P 500 index over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during early-cycle expansions (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate rises above 2%, it signals a tightening monetary cycle, leading to decreased borrowing and spending, which results in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns in tightening periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the unemployment rate indicates a weakening labor market, which leads to decreased consumer spending and subsequently drives down the S&P 500 index over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during late-cycle contractions (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production indicates a growing economy, which leads to higher demand for raw materials and subsequently drives up the S&P 500 index over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline when industrial production is increasing (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When both GDP growth rate and consumer spending are increasing, it signals a strong economy, leading to higher S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline when both GDP growth rate and consumer spending are increasing (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate is below 1% and the inflation rate is above 2%, it signals an accommodative monetary policy, leading to higher S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate is below 5% and the labor market is tightening, it signals a strong economy, leading to higher S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE < 5% and PAYEMS rises > 0.5% in 1 month
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline when the unemployment rate is below 5% and the labor market is tightening (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts are increasing and consumer spending is strong, it signals a growing economy, leading to higher S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST rises > 5% in 2 months and RSAFS rises > 2% in 1 month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline when housing starts are increasing and consumer spending is strong (t-test p > 0.05).
